parent="1"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e6" value="逐条检查" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;fontColor=#1B1F24;" edge="1" source="evaluate" target="rules" parent="1"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e8" value="汇总" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;fontColor=#1B1F24;" edge="1" source="rules" target="grade" parent="1"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
